title: Your bills, with more clarity
summary: Here’s what actually changed in this release of FullWorth.

highlights.title: Find out why a bill is missing
highlights.description: The Bills page now has a Missing a bill? explanation of imported payment coverage and why recurring candidates were rejected. It does not change your bank data.

highlights.title: Keep important bills in view
highlights.description: Previously detected bills that need another look have their own review list. Confirm a bill to keep monitoring it, even when newer transaction history is sparse.

highlights.title: More trustworthy bill amounts
highlights.description: Bill totals now rely on eligible posted charges, exclude pending payments and credits, and preserve the original currency without inventing conversions.

highlights.title: Updates that explain what changed
highlights.description: What’s New now uses published release notes, remembers what you have already read, and checks for new updates when you return to FullWorth.
